arm_notes.view:
# Agent views
This database also has pre-joined views whose names start with `av_`. The table `av_catalog` documents each view: its source tables, join conditions, and where every column comes from. Read `av_catalog` before choosing tables.
For any question about offered subjects (enrollments, offering departments, terms), prefer the view `av_library_offering_course` over joining base tables yourself.
arm_notes.join_text:
# Join knowledge
For any question about offered subjects (enrollments, offering departments, terms), use the table LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED for the offerings, and join it to SIS_SUBJECT_CODE and SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION instead of using other offering tables:
- LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER
- SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER
(both inner joins).

Grain of the joined rows: one row per offering and matching course-description row. SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION can hold several rows for one COURSE, so an offering can appear more than once.

Column sources: offering columns (term, subject, offering department and school, enrolled students) come from LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED. SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_CODE and SCHOOL_CODE come from SIS_SUBJECT_CODE. Course-level columns (department, school, degree-granting flag, course level, CIP code) come from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION. On joined rows, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME and SCHOOL_NAME equal SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_NAME and SCHOOL_NAME.
arm_notes.join_sql:
# Join knowledge
For any question about offered subjects (enrollments, offering departments, terms), build on the query below (for example as a WITH clause named library_offering_course) instead of joining base tables yourself.

```sql
WITH library_offering_course AS (
SELECT
    lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
    lso.TERM_CODE,
    lso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER,
    lso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_SORT,
    lso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_DESC,
    lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
    lso.COURSE_NUMBER,
    lso.COURSE_NUMBER_SORT,
    lso.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC,
    lso.SUBJECT_ID,
    lso.SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
    lso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
    lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    lso.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS LSO_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
    ssc.SUBJECT_CODE,
    ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
    ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    ssc.SCHOOL_CODE,
    ssc.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS SSC_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
    scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY,
    scd.COURSE,
    scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION,
    scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG,
    scd.DEPARTMENT,
    scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    scd.DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK,
    scd.SCHOOL_NAME,
    scd.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK,
    scd.FROM_TERM,
    scd.FROM_TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    scd.THRU_TERM,
    scd.THRU_TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    scd.COURSE_OPTION,
    scd.COURSE_LEVEL,
    scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE,
    scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING,
    scd.DEFAULT_ULTIMATE_DEGREE,
    scd.GRADAUTE_LEVEL,
    scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL,
    scd.LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE,
    scd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS SCD_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON lso.COURSE_NUMBER = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER
JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER
)
```

Notes on library_offering_course:
- Whole query: Subject offerings (LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED) joined with their course number (SIS_SUBJECT_CODE) and course description (SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION): LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER (inner joins). One row per offering and matching course-description row; SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION can hold several rows for one COURSE, so an offering can appear more than once.
- LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY..NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS: Columns from LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED, same names. COURSE_NUMBER equals SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER and SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE.
- SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_CODE, SCHOOL_CODE: Columns from SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, same names.
- SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY..GRADUATE_LEVEL, LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE: Columns from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, same names. DEPARTMENT_NAME and SCHOOL_NAME also equal SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.DEPARTMENT_NAME and SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_NAME on every row.
- LSO_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, SSC_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, SCD_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE: WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE of LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED, SIS_SUBJECT_CODE and SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION respectively.
